title: Dune Allen "Heron on Oyster Lake" 5456 West County Highway 30A
h1: Dune Allen "Heron on Oyster Lake" 5456 West County Highway 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Renovated in 2025- Private dock- Beach access across the street- Gulf and lake views- 4 adult bikes- Carport- 2 Paddle boards- Extended stay available- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Fun on the water and peaceful days by the shore are in store at Heron on Oyster Lake, a charming 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom Dune Allen home that sleeps 12! With a private dock, beach access across the street, and panoramic Oyster Lake and Gulf views, this 3-story retreat promises endless charm. Enjoy sunbathing on the beach, canoeing and paddleboarding on the lake, or sampling the variety of well-loved local eateries, including Stinky’s Fish Camp, The Perfect Pig, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, and the famous Blue Mountain Beach Creamery!The first level of this home features access to the private dock and a covered porch. Take in water views while grilling and dining at the outdoor table as string lights provide a cheerful glow, or settle into the porch swing for an evening nightcap. Inside, a washer and dryer add convenience.Venture to the second level, where natural light fills the connected living, dining, and kitchen spaces. Hardwood floors, a beamed ceiling, and nautical nods create an inviting atmosphere for relaxing with the group. The kitchen is well-equipped with high-end appliances and a center island with a breakfast bar for 3—perfect for entertaining guests while preparing a fresh seafood feast! When it’s time to eat, the wooden dining table hosts 6 for delightful family dinners. Afterward, gather in the living area on the 2 plush couches and 2 armchairs for a fun-filled movie night on the TV. Double doors lead to the open balcony with outdoor seating and incredible views of the sparkling lake and Gulf. The lovely second-floor primary bedroom boasts a plush king bed and private bathroom for added convenience. A full guest bathroom completes this floor.Retreat to the third level for restful nights and post-beach naps, boasting a serene guest bedroom with a king bed, alongside 2 cozy bunk rooms with a queen-over-king bed and a queen-over-queen bed, respectively. Lake and beach life combine for a delightful escape at Heron on Oyster Lake. Easily explore with on-site parking for 4 vehicles, 4 complimentary adult bikes, and 2 paddleboards for on-the-lake adventures. Beach access is a 2-minute walk away on the opposite side of the street. Book today and experience an exceptional 30A getaway!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 1 Queen Bed and 1 King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.

With a private dock, beach access across the street, and panoramic Oyster Lake and Gulf views, this 3-story retreat promises endless charm. Enjoy sunbathing on the beach, canoeing and paddleboarding on the lake, or sampling the variety of well-loved local eateries, including Stinky’s Fish Camp, The Perfect Pig, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, and the famous Blue Mountain Beach Creamery! The first level of this home features access to the private dock and a covered porch. Take in water views while grilling and dining at the outdoor table as string lights provide a cheerful glow, or settle into the porch swing for an evening nightcap. Inside, a washer and dryer add convenience. Venture to the second level, where natural light fills the connected living, dining, and kitchen spaces. Hardwood floors, a beamed ceiling, and nautical nods create an inviting atmosphere for relaxing with the group. The kitchen is well-equipped with high-end appliances and a center island with a breakfast bar for 3—perfect for entertaining guests while preparing a fresh seafood feast! When it’s time to eat, the wooden dining table hosts 6 for delightful family dinners. Afterward, gather in the living area on the 2 plush couches and 2 armchairs for a fun-filled movie night on the TV. Double doors lead to the open balcony with outdoor seating and incredible views of the sparkling lake and Gulf. The lovely second-floor primary bedroom boasts a plush king bed and private bathroom for added convenience. A full guest bathroom completes this floor. Retreat to the third level for restful nights and post-beach naps, boasting a serene guest bedroom with a king bed, alongside 2 cozy bunk rooms with a queen-over-king bed and a queen-over-queen bed, respectively. Lake and beach life combine for a delightful escape at Heron on Oyster Lake. Easily explore with on-site parking for 4 vehicles, 4 complimentary adult bikes, and 2 paddleboards for on-the-lake adventures. Beach access is a 2-minute walk away on the opposite side of the street. Book today and experience an exceptional 30A getaway!
